title: Chapter 267 - 267 15,721 Red Packets; A Great Harvest!
content:
Chapter 267 - 267 15,721 Red Packets; A Great Harvest!

Chapter 267 - 267 15,721 Red Packets; A Great Harvest!

267 15,721 Red Packets; A Great Harvest!

Back then, after Lin Fan agreed to help Ling Rou organize a concert, he immediately contacted Wang Fengyi.

Lin Fan explained the rough requirements and transferred 500 million yuan.

In Lin Fan’s mind… Wang Fengyi was able to manage the Imperial Hotel in an orderly manner, his ability should be pretty good.

From the results, Wang Fengyi did not disappoint Lin Fan’s trust.

…

When Wang Fengyi received 500 million yuan, he was a little stunned.

As the general manager of the Imperial Hotel, he had made friends with big shots from all walks of life. It could be said that he had a certain understanding of concerts.

Generally speaking, a few million yuan would be enough.

In the end, Lin Fan gave him 500 million!

500 million!

Was Lin Fan not afraid that he would run away with the money?

After being stunned for a while…

Wang Fengyi used all his connections to order the best audio equipment, display screens, clothes, and so on.

The reason why the final price was different from what many netizens had guessed was that the ten Rolls-Royce and the MD902 helicopter all belonged to Lin Fan. No money was spent on them!

Lin Fan curled his lips and said, “You only used that much?”

Wang Fengyi’s mouth twitched slightly.

That was 149 million yuan!

Was that a little?

This… His poverty had limited his imagination!

Lin Fan continued, “Alright, just send it to my Merchant Bank account.”

Just as he hung up the phone, a crisp notification sounded in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Level 7 reward: 100 yuan for every breath; 100 yuan for every second of sleep, and 100 yuan for every step taken. Rewards are distributed at 12 a.m. daily.]

At level 6, he could earn about 3.5 million yuan per day.

Now, the reward was doubled!

In other words, he could earn about 7 million yuan a day.

Even though Lin Fan did not lack money now, when he saw the system that had not been upgraded for a long time being upgraded again, he could not help but smile.

[Upgrade cost: 69.8 million/500 million (not including gifts and gambling. In addition, all items obtained from the system are prohibited from being traded.]

Lin Fan was in a good mood. He slowly placed his attention on the silver packets and muttered in his heart, ‘I received a total of 10 silver packets from this mission. Let’s see what I can get.’

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 500,000 yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 200,000 yuan.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained Haoting Building.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 100,000 yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained Xin Mei Entertainment.]

With ten silver packets, Lin Fan received a total of 2.7 million yuan, a luxury building, and Xin Mei Entertainment.

Seeing this…

Lin Fan could not help but reveal a strange look.

2.7 million yuan was nothing to worry about.

Haoting Building was a newly built high-end office building. When Lin Fan was playing with his phone, he accidentally saw a piece of news. It seemed that this building was located by the river and had a total investment of five billion yuan.

It had just been built… but it became his?

In addition, he also got Xin Mei Entertainment?

Even though Lin Fan did not know much about the entertainment industry, the name Xin Mei Entertainment would often appear at the beginning of movies and TV shows.

Obviously, Xin Mei Entertainment had a certain level of strength.

In other words, he helped Ling Rou hold a concert and then obtained a large entertainment company?

Lin Fan rubbed his nose and muttered, “Looks like my luck today is pretty good?”

Hence, he turned his gaze to the check-in system.

“Sign in!”

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a double shares coupon.]

Seeing this…

Lin Fan’s eyes lit up.

Doubling shares was definitely a good thing!

Not long ago, after he used it on Penguin Group, he directly increased his shares from 5% to 10%, causing Lin Fan’s assets to instantly increase by 250 billion yuan!

Now that he had obtained another one, if he continued to use it on Penguin Group… Then, Lin Fan’s shares in Penguin Group would reach 20%! His assets would increase by 500 billion yuan!

However, Lin Fan did not immediately use the double shares coupon. Instead, he thought about it for a while before making a decision.

[Ding! Do you want to use the double shares coupon for Little Tanuki Group?]

“Yes!]

[Ding! Successfully used. You now own 10% of the shares of Little Tanuki.]

Using the double shares coupon on Penguin Group could yield more benefits, but Lin Fan’s goal was to take back most of the shares of Penguin Group and Little Tanuki Group that were in the hands of foreigners.

Thus, there was no need to care about temporary gains and losses.

Last time, he chose Penguin Group. This time, he chose Little Tanuki Group. This way, he would not be biased.

Little Tanuki’s market value was five trillion yuan, and now he had an additional 5% shares.

Hence, Lin Fan’s assets increased by another 250 billion!

Lin Fan rubbed his nose and smiled, “Looks like…Today’s luck is indeed not bad.”

Then, he turned his attention to his phone.

At this moment, there were 15,712 unclaimed red packets on the screen.

Among them, 14,900 red packets were earned from spending 149 million yuan on this concert.

The rest were the millions that he spent in the past.

In the past, the reason why he did not open the packets was that he wanted to collect 1,000 of them and open them together.

Now, he had gathered 15,712 of them!

This was the first time he had so many red packets.

Lin Fan thought that his luck was pretty good today. Without any hesitation, he chose to open all of them.

[Ding! Congratulations, you have received 3 yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 5 yuan.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained a land certificate.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 19,999 yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained the double skill card.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a skill level upgrade card.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained a land certificate.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained a one yuan critical hit card.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained Expert-Level Dancing Technique.]

…

These 15,721 red packets gave Lin Fan a total of 2,320,811 yuan. Lin Fan acted as if he did not see this amount of money and ignored it.

His gaze first fell on the land certificate.

[Land certificate: After use, you can obtain land within 10,000 square meters and the ownership of all the buildings on it. More land means more wealth, and at the same time, it’ll show more charm.]

Seeing this…

Lin Fan’s eyes lit up.

One had to know that the total area of a typical residential area was only about 5,000 square meters.

10,000 square meters meant that he could own two residential areas?

If it was some office buildings that were closer to each other, he could probably own several of them, right?

Land certificates were definitely a rare treasure!

As for himself… he had just obtained two land certificates!

Even Lin Fan could not help but smile.
